summary: Establish a minimal Inventory domain module with a direct dependency on a concrete PostgreSQL persistence module (baseline, before dependency inversion).
goal: Give the Inventory domain a place to persist stock rows, as a starting point for a later dependency-inversion example.

in_scope.text: Define inventory (domain) and a concrete PostgresInventoryStore (infrastructure) with a direct inventory -> postgres_store dependency

out_of_scope.text: Any implementation in src/ — this whole example is a structural design artifact, not a runnable project
Introducing a port/interface abstraction — that is the point of the follow-on change invert-inventory-persistence-dependency

success_criteria.text: ArchitecturePlan documents inventory, postgres_store, and the direct inventory -> postgres_store dependency, and passes solidsdd-lint / critique(architecture_plan) cleanly
